#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

LOG="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/retnet_redownload_eval.log"
echo "=== Waiting for ModelScope download to finish ===" > "$LOG"
echo "Started at $(date)" >> "$LOG"

# Wait for ModelScope download to complete
while true; do
    # Check if the download screen is still running
    if ! screen -ls | grep -q redownload; then
        echo "Download screen exited at $(date)" >> "$LOG"
        break
    fi
    sleep 30
done

# Check download result
MS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b/retnet_ms_cache/m-a-p/1.3B-100B-RetNet-pure"
if [ ! -f "$MS_DIR/model-00001-of-00002.safetensors" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: shard 1 not found at $MS_DIR" >> "$LOG"
    exit 1
fi
SHARD1_SIZE=$(stat -c "%s" "$MS_DIR/model-00001-of-00002.safetensors")
echo "Shard 1 size: $SHARD1_SIZE" >> "$LOG"
if [ "$SHARD1_SIZE" -lt 4000000000 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: shard 1 too small ($SHARD1_SIZE bytes)" >> "$LOG"
    exit 1
fi

# Verify checkpoint integrity
echo "Verifying checkpoint integrity..." >> "$LOG"
python -c "
from safetensors.torch import load_file
import os, sys
path = '$MS_DIR'
ckpt1 = load_file(os.path.join(path, 'model-00001-of-00002.safetensors'))
zero_count = sum(1 for k,v in ckpt1.items() if v.float().norm().item() == 0)
total = len(ckpt1)
print(f'Shard 1: {zero_count}/{total} zero tensors')
if zero_count > 10:
    print('ERROR: Too many zero tensors - checkpoint still corrupted')
    sys.exit(1)
print('Checkpoint looks good!')
" >> "$LOG" 2>&1
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Checkpoint verification failed" >> "$LOG"
    exit 1
fi

# Replace corrupted model
echo "Replacing corrupted model..." >> "$LOG"
TARGET="/root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b/1.3B-100B-RetNet-pure"
cp "$MS_DIR/model-00001-of-00002.safetensors" "$TARGET/model-00001-of-00002.safetensors"
echo "Copied new shard 1 to $TARGET" >> "$LOG"

# Run evaluation
echo "=== Starting lm_eval at $(date) ===" >> "$LOG"
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1

# Remove old broken result
rm -f /root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/1.3B-100B-RetNet-pure.json

python /root/entrainment_gated_ft/run_lmeval_clean.py \
    --model_path "$TARGET" \
    --tasks "lambada_openai,hellaswag,winogrande,arc_easy,arc_challenge,mmlu" \
    --output_dir /root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean \
    --batch_size 16 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"

echo "=== DONE at $(date) ===" >> "$LOG"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/run_retnet_after_download.sh
echo "Script created"
